summary: A first complete abstract architecture for The Wandering Islands, a twelve-Book fantasy series built directly from the Story Vision. Proposed causal organization (agent proposal; engine_hierarchy is UNKNOWN): primary_with_layers. The primary engine is the unreturned island: a break in the one pattern every community trusted (every known inhabited island has eventually returned). That break owns the series question and powers three subordinate, renewable layers: (1) a migration-uncertainty engine that keeps reshaping who is near and who is far; (2) a bond-maintenance engine in which markets, celebrations, shared craft and generosity are tested and reinvented under the new uncertainty; (3) an interpretation-and-opportunity engine in which competing readings of the disappearance produce choices with real consequences. Fantasy governs the reader promise (wonder, beauty, a world worth inhabiting, warm belonging); mystery supports it by turning the absence into a long investigative arc of changing understanding; exploration-adventure supports it by widening scale while keeping intimate stakes. The macro trajectory moves from settled wonder through rupture, division and outward discovery to a reframed understanding of the world and an earned, costly hope that is never guaranteed. Consequential provisional choices are recorded as interpretations: that the migrations have an underlying order the series may progressively reveal, that earned hope does not require the island's restoration, and that scale grows outward from communities rather than replacing them.

nodes.title: Earned hope
nodes.summary: The governing reader promise: hope that is paid for by choices, effort and generosity, and that could have failed. Victory is never predetermined; hope is the reward of sustained practice under real uncertainty.

nodes.title: Wonder and a world worth inhabiting
nodes.summary: Readers feel the archipelago as beautiful and alive: moving islands, shifting seas and the cultures that grew around them invite delight and awe rather than only threat.

nodes.title: Warm belonging
nodes.summary: Everyday life, friendship and community are felt as precious. Readers want these bonds to survive, which is what makes the disappearance and its pressures matter.

nodes.title: Complicated choices that matter
nodes.summary: Readers weigh decisions with no clean answer, see their costs land, and watch them shape later Books rather than reset.

nodes.title: Growing scale without losing intimacy
nodes.summary: Each widening of the world is felt through specific friendships and households, so larger stakes never erase the human-sized concerns that make them meaningful.

nodes.title: Luminous mutable geography
nodes.summary: The aesthetic of a world whose map is never final: horizons that change, familiar places made distant, new adjacencies made possible. Beauty is rendered through motion and rearrangement rather than fixed landmarks.

nodes.title: Domestic and craft texture
nodes.summary: Close attention to markets, seasonal celebrations, shared craftsmanship and small generosities, giving warmth a tactile, lived-in surface that later pressure can visibly strain.

nodes.title: Wonder-centered secondary-world fantasy
nodes.summary: Governing genre (stated by the author as a fantasy series). Supplies the impossible-but-real world rule of migrating inhabited islands, the promise of wonder and beauty, and the frame of courageous, generous heroism.

nodes.title: Long-horizon world mystery
nodes.summary: Supporting genre (the author names mystery). The unreturned island is the central mystery problem; investigation, clues, false leads and revelations progressively change how the communities understand their world.

nodes.title: Exploration adventure
nodes.summary: Supporting genre (the author names exploration and growing scale). Voyages beyond familiar routes turn the shifting geography into frontier and widen the series' scope Book by Book.

nodes.title: The living world as marvel
nodes.summary: Function: make the setting itself an object of delight and curiosity, so that understanding it more deeply is a reward rather than a disenchantment.

nodes.title: Ordinary generous heroism
nodes.summary: Function: heroism expressed as generosity and courage on behalf of others, rooted in community practices rather than chosen-one destiny, so heroic acts reinforce belonging.

nodes.title: The place that did not return
nodes.summary: Function: an absence that is also a question. The missing inhabited island anchors grief, curiosity and responsibility at once, and keeps its people present through their absence.

nodes.title: Rival interpretations
nodes.summary: Function: competing explanations of the disappearance act as theories in a mystery and as values in conflict, so being wrong carries social and moral cost, not only puzzle failure.

nodes.title: Voyage beyond known routes
nodes.summary: Function: departure from the familiar migration cycle into the unknown, turning uncertainty into discovery and widening the map of what is possible.

nodes.title: Primary engine: the broken pattern
nodes.summary: Causal owner of the series question. The one trusted regularity fails, and every attempt to explain, exploit, mourn or reverse that failure generates pressure, action and revelation. Renewable because each partial answer reopens what else communities assumed was stable.

nodes.title: Layer: shifting proximity
nodes.summary: Unpredictable migrations keep rearranging distance and adjacency. Renewable pressure: alliances, friendships, trade and help become possible or impossible as geography moves, independent of any single plot line.

nodes.title: Layer: sustaining bonds across distance
nodes.summary: Communities act through practices (traveling markets, celebrations, shared craft, generosity) to keep relationships alive. The disappearance tests whether those practices can adapt, producing repeated action families of reaching out, keeping faith and repairing.

nodes.title: Layer: interpretation, opportunity and consequence
nodes.summary: Competing readings of the disappearance lead groups toward different responses; the vacancy also creates opportunities. Choices made from incomplete understanding produce consequences that carry forward, generating reversals when understanding changes.

nodes.title: The series question of the missing island
nodes.summary: A continuous thread across all twelve Books: what happened, what it means, and what the communities owe the island and its people. Its answer is deliberately left open in this architecture.

nodes.title: Practices tested and reinvented
nodes.summary: A continuing thread tracking how migration-era customs strain, fail, adapt or are newly invented as the world changes, so culture itself has an arc.

nodes.title: Belonging across distance
nodes.summary: Whether and how people remain each other's community when the places that held them move apart; belonging as something done, not merely located.

nodes.title: Changing understanding
nodes.summary: Knowledge of the world is provisional; confidence in patterns can be both wisdom and blindness. Growth means revising understanding without abandoning care.

nodes.title: Hope as practice
nodes.summary: Hope is enacted through generosity, courage and maintenance of bonds rather than owed by the world, linking the governing reader promise to the communities' customs.

nodes.title: Series structure: widening rings
nodes.summary: Agent proposal: twelve Books move outward in scope in rings (intimate community, inter-island relations, the wider archipelago, the nature of the world), with each ring re-grounded in intimate concerns. Ring boundaries and Book counts per ring remain unknown.

nodes.title: Book pattern: local question within the series question
nodes.summary: Agent proposal: each Book carries its own answerable question and payoff while advancing the series question one step, so Books satisfy individually and the twelve-Book arc accumulates.

nodes.title: World rule: genuine migration
nodes.summary: Author constraint: islands truly change position; migrations are currently unpredictable to communities; customs have formed around them; every known inhabited island has previously returned within its cycle until this year.

phases.title: Living with the moving world

trope_functions: establish the living world as marvel
show customs that sustain bonds across distance
genre_activations.structural_function: Establish the world rule, its beauty and the customs built around migration so readers learn what is at stake before the pattern breaks.

phases.reader_experience: Delight in a world worth inhabiting and attachment to its communities.
phases.aesthetic: Luminous motion, domestic warmth and craft detail.
phases.narrative_function: Setup: plant the trusted regularity of return and the bond-keeping practices that later pressure will test. Duration unknown; may be brief within the first Book.
phases.transition: The expected return does not happen, turning the trusted pattern into a question.

phases.title: The absence registers

trope_functions: frame the missing island as both grief and question
genre_activations.structural_function: Introduce the central mystery problem and the first clues and uncertainties, without resolving cause or fate.

phases.reader_experience: Unease and grief entering a warm world; curiosity sharpened by care.
phases.aesthetic: Familiar customs performed around an empty place.
phases.narrative_function: Rupture: the primary engine starts; communities first respond with existing practices and discover their limits.
phases.transition: Responses diverge as people form incompatible explanations.

phases.title: Interpretations divide

trope_functions: turn rival theories into conflicting values with social cost
use false leads that reveal assumptions
genre_activations.structural_function: Competing interpretations and opportunities produce consequential choices and conflicts between communities that formerly cooperated.

phases.reader_experience: Divided sympathies and the weight of choices made without full knowledge.
phases.aesthetic: Bonds visibly strained in markets and celebrations.
phases.narrative_function: Complication: the interpretation-and-opportunity layer dominates; costs begin to accumulate and carry forward.
phases.transition: Someone must go beyond known routes to test what others only argue.

phases.title: Venturing outward

trope_functions: leave the familiar migration cycle to widen the map
genre_activations.structural_function: Widen scope ring by ring; discoveries feed the mystery while new places renew wonder.

phases.reader_experience: Expanding awe with intimate anchors carried along.
phases.aesthetic: Unfamiliar horizons rendered against remembered home textures.
phases.narrative_function: Expansion: may overlap with division at home; scale grows while bonds are maintained across greater distance.
phases.transition: Accumulated discoveries make the old model of the world untenable.

phases.title: Understanding transforms

trope_functions: deliver revelations that reframe earlier choices
genre_activations.structural_function: Revelation and reversal: earlier interpretations are reframed, some vindicated, some shown costly; the world becomes larger and stranger without becoming less beautiful.

phases.reader_experience: Reframing surprise and renewed wonder at a deeper world.
phases.narrative_function: Reversal: the series question is answered in part, and the answer creates new obligations. Extent of explanation is an author decision.
phases.transition: New understanding demands costly action on behalf of others.

phases.title: Generous courage under cost

trope_functions: express heroism as generosity rooted in community practice
genre_activations.structural_function: Convergence: the layers meet in choices where generosity and courage risk real loss, paying off setups of practice and bond.

phases.reader_experience: Fear for people readers love, and pride in their generosity.
phases.aesthetic: Customs transformed into acts of rescue and repair.
phases.narrative_function: Climax of the series trajectory; payoff for earlier consequential choices. Not guaranteed to succeed in every respect.
phases.transition: The outcome settles into a changed but living community.

phases.title: Earned hope

trope_functions: reaffirm belonging as practice in a changed world
genre_activations.structural_function: Resolution: belonging reconstituted around new understanding and new or renewed customs; hope shown as earned, with losses honored.

phases.aesthetic: A new celebration or custom shaped by what was learned.
phases.narrative_function: Payoff of the governing promise without predetermined victory; whether the island returns remains an author decision.

open_questions: Should the series ultimately allow permanent loss of the missing island and its people, or does earned hope include some form of return or reunion?
How far should the migrations be explained by the end: fully explicable, partially understood, or enduringly mysterious?
Does the author prefer a single central viewpoint, a small set of linked viewpoints, or a broad ensemble across communities?
Should each Book resolve its own local question, or may some Books end on open turns of the series question?
How dark may consequences become (lasting harm, deaths, broken communities) while keeping the warm, hopeful promise?

opportunities.title: The missing island's own community as a counter-perspective
opportunities.why_it_matters: The vision frames the disappearance from the communities left behind. Treating the absent island as still inhabited and still acting could make belonging across distance reciprocal and give the mystery a second side.
opportunities.artistic_potential: Doubles the theme of sustaining bonds across distance, creates dramatic irony and lets the series question become a meeting rather than only a search.
opportunities.intention_fidelity: Consistent with wonder, warmth and earned hope; it adds content the author has not established and would shape the mystery's answer, so it stays a possibility only.

interpretations.interpretation: Working reading: the migrations follow an underlying order that is not currently predictable to the communities but that the series may progressively reveal, so the mystery can deliver genuine revelations about the world.
interpretations.consequences: Enables a long investigative arc with clues and reversals and lets deeper understanding renew wonder. It also risks disenchanting the world if explanation becomes mechanical.
interpretations.alternative: The migrations remain fundamentally unexplained; the mystery then centers on the missing island's fate and on how communities live with irreducible uncertainty.

interpretations.interpretation: Working reading of 'earned hope rather than predetermined victory': the series does not presume the missing island returns; hope is earned through how communities respond, whatever the island's fate.
interpretations.consequences: Keeps stakes real across twelve Books and prevents the series question from becoming a countdown to restoration. Endings must honor loss as well as success.
interpretations.alternative: Earned hope includes an eventual return or reunion, with the cost carried by the journey rather than by the outcome.

interpretations.interpretation: Working reading of 'growing scale without abandoning intimate concerns': scope widens in rings outward from communities, each expansion re-grounded in specific bonds, rather than shifting to large-scale conflict that sidelines everyday life.
interpretations.consequences: Shapes pacing across twelve Books and keeps warmth and domestic texture present in late Books; limits how far the series can pivot toward epic war or politics.
interpretations.alternative: A pivot in which later Books adopt a predominantly large-scale conflict frame, with intimacy carried mainly by a few central bonds.

interpretations.interpretation: Working causal organization (agent proposal, engine_hierarchy UNKNOWN): the unreturned island is the primary engine, with shifting proximity, bond maintenance and interpretation-opportunity as subordinate layers.
interpretations.consequences: Gives the series a single long question that unifies twelve Books, while the layers supply renewable Book-level pressure.
interpretations.alternative: An ensemble organization in which the shifting geography and community life co-govern, with the disappearance as one of several equal pressures.

emotion_targets.intended_effect: Readers finish Books and the series feeling hope that was paid for and could have failed.
emotion_targets.eliciting_condition: Generous and courageous action under real uncertainty produces partial, costly success that sustains community.
emotion_targets.aesthetic_strategy: Withhold easy rescue; let customs and bonds visibly carry people through; honor losses alongside gains.

emotion_targets.intended_effect: Readers feel awe and delight at a beautiful world that moves and keeps revealing more of itself.
emotion_targets.eliciting_condition: Migrations, new adjacencies, voyages beyond routes and revelations about how the world works.
emotion_targets.aesthetic_strategy: Render geography through motion and changing horizons; let understanding deepen marvel rather than flatten it.

emotion_targets.intended_effect: Readers feel at home among friendships and communities and want them to endure.
emotion_targets.eliciting_condition: Everyday life, traveling markets, seasonal celebrations, shared craft and acts of generosity.
emotion_targets.aesthetic_strategy: Domestic and craft texture; small recurring rituals that later pressure can strain and that can be reinvented.

emotion_targets.intended_effect: Readers fear for people they love as they act courageously, so heroism carries weight.
emotion_targets.eliciting_condition: Characters risk safety, standing or bonds on behalf of others in the face of the unknown.
emotion_targets.aesthetic_strategy: Make costs concrete and consequences persistent across Books.

emotion_targets.intended_effect: Readers feel the absence of the missing island and its people as a real loss within a warm world.
emotion_targets.eliciting_condition: Customs and relationships that once included the island continue around an empty place.
emotion_targets.aesthetic_strategy: Show absence through familiar practices performed incompletely rather than through spectacle.

emotion_targets.intended_effect: Readers feel the heat of conflict when communities blame each other or exploit the vacancy.
emotion_targets.eliciting_condition: Rival interpretations and opportunism produce actions that harm others.
emotion_targets.aesthetic_strategy: Present rival positions with sympathy so anger complicates choices instead of simplifying them.

emotion_targets.intended_effect: Readers recoil when the disappearance is used for selfish gain against communal values.
emotion_targets.eliciting_condition: Opportunities created by the vacancy are seized in ways that betray generosity.
emotion_targets.aesthetic_strategy: Contrast betrayal against established generosity customs; keep it local, not a governing tone.

emotion_targets.intended_effect: Readers experience revelations that change how earlier events and choices are understood.
emotion_targets.eliciting_condition: Clues and discoveries overturn a confident interpretation of the world.
emotion_targets.aesthetic_strategy: Fair-play setups whose payoffs reframe without invalidating earlier warmth.

complex_emotions.title: Awe
complex_emotions.context: Contextual reading: the vastness and motion of the world elicits delight edged with smallness before something larger than the communities understand.

complex_emotions.title: Bittersweet longing
complex_emotions.context: Contextual reading: friendship sustained across changing seas, where reunion and separation are both part of belonging.

complex_emotions.title: Hard-won hope
complex_emotions.context: Contextual reading: hope held after fear and loss, the series' governing aftertaste rather than triumph.

trope_functions: make the world itself a marvel worth understanding
express heroism as generosity rooted in community practice
genre_contracts.narrative_engine: The world rule of genuine migration keeps reshaping proximity; communities act to sustain bonds, and heroism emerges as generous, courageous action that keeps belonging alive under the pressure of the broken pattern.
genre_contracts.structural_pattern: Settled wonder, rupture, strain and expansion, convergence in costly generosity, and resolution in earned hope across twelve Books, each Book re-grounding scale in intimate concerns.
aesthetic_strategies: customs as visible measures of community health
payoff_expectations: The world remains worth inhabiting at the end
Generous acts are shown to matter and to cost
Belonging is reaffirmed in a changed form

trope_functions: keep the absent island present as grief and question
turn rival theories into conflicting values with social cost
genre_contracts.narrative_engine: The unreturned island is the central mystery problem; investigative arcs gather clues and false leads, and revelations change understanding, reframing earlier consequential choices.
genre_contracts.structural_pattern: A series-long question advanced one step per Book, with local Book mysteries resolving while the larger answer deepens; partial revelations precede a major reframing late in the series.
payoff_expectations: Clues planted early are paid off
Changing understanding reframes but does not cheapen earlier warmth
The series question receives a meaningful answer, whose extent remains an author decision

trope_functions: leave the familiar migration cycle to widen the map
genre_contracts.narrative_engine: Unpredictable geography becomes frontier; voyages test theories of the disappearance and widen scope while carrying home bonds along.
genre_contracts.structural_pattern: Widening rings of scope across the series, overlapping with home-front division, each ring returning to intimate stakes.
aesthetic_strategies: new horizons against remembered home textures
payoff_expectations: Each expansion of scope reveals something that matters to the series question

genre_interactions.mechanism: The fantasy world rule supplies a trusted regularity whose failure becomes the central mystery problem; without migrating islands there is no broken pattern.
Investigation seeks to explain the world while fantasy promises wonder; revelations must deepen marvel rather than reduce the world to mechanism.
genre_interactions.risk: Over-explanation of migrations could disenchant the governing wonder promise.

genre_interactions.mechanism: Voyages beyond known routes are how theories are tested and clues found, so expansion of scope and progress on the series question advance together.
genre_interactions.risk: Exploration could become episodic travelogue if discoveries do not bear on the series question.

genre_interactions.mechanism: The warm-belonging promise requires that outward expansion keep returning to intimate community stakes, limiting how far adventure can detach from home.
